source.description: C3 Symphony ownership recovery gap found by the first real PersonalHub batch: release_unstarted_symphony_run can mark a run failed and remove C3 resource leases after the worker fails before external binding/tracker publication, but reserve_ownership may already have persisted a durable reserved owner. The successor run is then rejected with symphony_ownership_conflict although the prior run has no tracker, binding, result, or worktree changes. Add a safe evidence-gated recovery/retirement path for reserved ownership from a failed unstarted run; do not weaken ownership protection for published or ambiguous runs.
